name: Checkbox
description: A control for an independent on/off choice, rendered as a button with role="checkbox". It supports checked, unchecked, and indeterminate (a partial-selection dash) states across the full interaction set — default, hover, focus, active, and disabled — and binds its fill, border, radius, and focus ring to the system's semantic tokens.
whenToUse: Offer an independent on/off choice, like accepting terms
Select any number of options from a list (zero, one, or many)
Represent a parent's partial selection with the indeterminate state
whenNotToUse: Choosing exactly one option from a set — use a Radio group
A single setting that applies immediately with no Save — use a Switch

checked.false: Unchecked — empty box with a neutral border.
checked.true: Checked — brand fill with a check glyph.
checked.indeterminate: Partial — brand fill with a dash, for a mixed parent state.

states.hover: Pointer over the box — border strengthens when unchecked.
states.focus: Keyboard focus — shows the focus ring.

dos: Give every checkbox a visible, clickable label
Use the indeterminate state only for a parent summarizing mixed children
Group related checkboxes under a clear group label
donts: Don't use a checkbox for a one-of-many choice — that's a Radio group
Don't use it for a setting that takes effect instantly — prefer a Switch
Don't leave the box unlabeled or rely on placement alone for meaning

keyboard: Tab moves focus to and from the control
notes: State is exposed via aria-checked, with "mixed" for indeterminate
Disabled checkboxes are dimmed and not interactive
The visible label should be programmatically associated with the control
